status_definitions.READY: Official/approved source is identified and sufficient to begin normalization.
status_definitions.PARTIAL: Useful official source exists but material gaps, license review, coverage or normalization remain.
status_definitions.QUERY_ONLY: Official query/document flow exists but is not approved as bulk reusable data.
status_definitions.PRIVATE_ON_DEMAND: Information belongs to private/restricted due-diligence workflow.
status_definitions.GAP: No sufficient approved source is currently registered.
